def mask_to_points(mask, depth, K, cam_ext):
    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
    zs = depth[ys, xs]
    valid = zs > 0
    xs, ys, zs = xs[valid], ys[valid], zs[valid]
    fx, fy = K[0, 0], K[1, 1]
    cx, cy = K[0, 2], K[1, 2]
    x = (xs - cx) * zs / fx
    y = (ys - cy) * zs / fy
    pts_cam = np.stack([x, y, zs], axis=1)

    pts_world = (cam_ext @ pts_cam_h.T).T[:, :3]
    return pts_world

    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
    zs = depth[ys, xs]
    valid = zs > 0
    xs, ys, zs = xs[valid], ys[valid], zs[valid]

    pts_cam = np.stack([x, y, zs], axis=1)

    Returns:
        masks:
